name: web-minimal-footer-component-with-hexagon-logo-and-link-columns
title: White footer with a hexagon logo and name, two round social buttons, copyright and right-aligned link columns
whatItIs: A white frame with a bordered hexagon logo and 'Awesome Corp' at the left, two round grey icon buttons for social links at the right, a hairline, a small copyright at the left and two rows of links (Products, About, Blog, Contact; Privacy, Terms) right-aligned.
whatItMeans: Tidy and neutral; a footer stripped to essentials.
techniques: Use a simple outlined hexagon logo.

vocabulary.definition: A set of links aligned at the footer's edge.
A round button with a platform icon.
Small links for privacy and terms.
